_comment: Build-phase SARB repo rate and prime rate decisions — MPC decisions effective from 2026-01-01. SARB held at 8.25% repo until the MPC decision on 2026-03-26, which cut 25bp to 8.00%. Prime = repo + 3.5% per South African banking convention. Used by the build-phase SARB repo rate ingester (platform/market-data/sarb-repo-prime-ingester.ts) to seed rate decision ticks into MarketDataStore for IRS pricing and ALM discount curve construction.
_provenance: Build-phase fixture variant. Production SARB MPC decision ingestion (live SARB published rates) is sequenced post-licence. Ticks carry provenance=production in MarketDataStore (SARB is a regulator-grade source) and fixingVariant=build-phase-fixture in payload.
_rate_regime: 2026-01-01: Repo 8.25%, Prime 11.75% (SARB held rate from prior MPC). 2026-03-26: Repo 8.00%, Prime 11.50% (MPC cut 25bp). These are the only two MPC decisions in the fixture window.
